/**
 * @name Unsafe pickle deserialization
 * @description Using pickle.load/loads on untrusted data can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-pickle-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("_pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("pandas").getMember("compat").getMember("pickle_compat").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe pickle deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code if data is untrusted."
findings.hypothesis: Detect unsafe pickle deserialization operations that could lead to arbitrary code execution when loading untrusted data

/**
 * @name Path traversal in file operations
 * @description Using unsanitized user input in file paths can allow access to arbitrary files
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/path-traversal
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // File open operations
    call = API::builtin("open").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("io").getMember("open").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getACall() or
    // Pandas specific file operations
    call = API::moduleImport("pandas").getMember(["read_csv", "read_excel", "read_json", "read_pickle", "read_hdf", "read_parquet"]).getACall()
  ) and
  // Check if path argument exists
  exists(call.getArg(0))
select call, "File operation that may be vulnerable to path traversal if path is user-controlled."

import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

where
  (
    // lxml.etree parsing without safe settings
    call = API::moduleImport("lxml").getMember("etree").getMember(["parse", "fromstring", "XML", "XMLParser"]).getACall() or
    // xml.etree.ElementTree parsing
    call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("etree").getMember("ElementTree").getMember(["parse", "fromstring", "XML"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("etree").getMember(["parse", "fromstring", "XML"]).getACall() or
    // xml.dom.minidom parsing

  )

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS)
 * @description Regular expressions with exponential worst-case complexity can lead to denial of service
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/redos
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "match", "search", "findall", "finditer", "sub", "subn", "split"]).getACall()
  ) and
  // Check if the pattern contains potentially problematic constructs
  exists(StrConst pattern |
    pattern = call.getArg(0).asExpr() and
    (
      // Nested quantifiers like (a+)+ or (a*)*
      pattern.getText().regexpMatch(".*\\([^)]*[+*]\\)[+*].*") or
      // Alternation with overlapping patterns
      pattern.getText().regexpMatch(".*(\\||\\[)[^)]*[+*].*")
    )
  )
select call, "Regular expression that may be vulnerable to ReDoS attacks."
findings.hypothesis: Regular expressions with nested quantifiers or complex patterns that could cause exponential backtracking leading to ReDoS
